 Somehow, Crystal Palace are ahead at the break.

 Post published at 20:32 GMT 20:32 GMT 
 Fulham 0-1 Crystal Palace 
 All of Fulham's joy seems to be coming down this right-hand side and Oscar Bobb.
 His latest ball is looped back from the byline and it's a good opportunity for Sander Berge but his header sails over the bar.
 41 17 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 20:31 GMT 20:31 GMT 
 Click 'Get Involved' on this page to have your say 
 Nyoni already showing why he is pushing for that first team place. So composed and brave on the ball.
 Paul 
 197 26 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 20:31 GMT 20:31 GMT 
 Liverpool 0-0 Chelsea 
 Liverpool have the opportunity to cause a bit of danger in the box with a Joe Gomez long throw. He sends the ball into the area and the ball does bounce among Chelsea and Liverpool players, but the visitors are able to clear.
 68 23 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 20:30 GMT 20:30 GMT 
 Click 'Get Involved' on this page to have your say 
 Wonder what Chelsea fans think watching Rio knowing he was their player.
 Lee 
 213 79 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 20:30 GMT 20:30 GMT 
 Fulham 0-1 Crystal Palace 
 Fulham have had 74% possession so far in this game. Four shots with one on target.
 Palace have had one shot on target - Eddie Nketiah's goal. In fact, that has been their only touch in the Fulham box so far.
 114 36 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Ngumoha gets fans off their seats published at 20:29 GMT 20:29 GMT 
 Liverpool 0-0 Chelsea 
 Aadam Patel 
Football Reporter at Anfield 
 It's something that I think we'll get used to saying but there really is something about Rio Ngumoha that gets fans off their seats, when he has the ball.
 We're also getting used to hearing the "Rio, Rio" chant around Anfield. 
 254 61 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 20:28 GMT 20:28 GMT 
 Bournemouth 1-0 Aston Villa 
 Emiliano Buendía should do better really as he gets the ball just outside the box but can only drag a tame effort wide. He had space to produce something better there, really.
 60 30 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 20:28 GMT 20:28 GMT 
 Fulham 0-1 Crystal Palace 
 A nice looking ball into the box from Oscar Bobb and Rodrigo Muniz's header is straight to Dean Henderson but it's a strange bit of goalkeeping from the Palace shot stopper, who has been out for a while.
 Bit rusty?
 47 27 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 GOAL - Sunderland 3-1 Brentford published at 20:27 GMT 20:27 GMT 
 Callum Wilson (42 mins) 
 Back in it?
 Jadon Anthony picks out Callum Wilson , who is level with the penalty spot, and he scuffs a volley into the turf before it flies into the bottom corner. 
 What a game. 
 224 176 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 20:26 GMT 20:26 GMT 
 Fulham 0-1 Crystal Palace 
 Talk about against the run of play.
 Just how important could that goal be for the Eagles?
 Benjamin Lecomte is fuming with Joachim Andersen after he failed to put up Eddie Nketiah.
 123 39 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 McConnell has to be 'careful' published at 20:25 GMT 20:25 GMT 
 Liverpool 0-0 Chelsea 
 Clinton Morrison 
Former Crystal Palace striker on BBC Radio 5 Live 
 He has to be careful.
 The thing is with these young players on yellow cards, [the manager] might look at half-time and think we might have to sacrifice you because we can't afford to go down to 10 men.
 It was a big horrible touch from McConnell, he tries to make amends and he stuck a hand out.
 81 57 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 GOAL - Sunderland 3-0 Brentford published at 20:24 GMT 20:24 GMT 
 Malick Fofana (39 mins) 
 Who needs to play a first 11?!
 Sunderland are absolutely flying in this first half despite changing all 11 players in their side. 
 Malick Fofana is there at the back stick to head his side into a 3-0 lead after Jocelin Ta Bi's cross. 
 574 117 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 20:24 GMT 20:24 GMT 
 Liverpool 0-0 Chelsea 
 Anfield raises its voice as Rio Ngumoha surges forward. He feeds the overlapping Konstantinos Tsimikas but his low cross is hacked away.
 104 36 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 GOAL - Fulham 0-1 Crystal Palace published at 20:23 GMT 20:23 GMT 
 Eddie Nketiah (37 mins) 
 Out of nowhere!
 It has been all Fulham so far but somehow Crystal Palace are ahead after a brilliant counter-attack.
 A lovely ball into the box from Oscar Mingueza and Eddie Nketiah has timed his run superbly to guide into the corner.
 A lovely finish.
 736 187 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 20:22 GMT 20:22 GMT 
 Bournemouth 1-0 Aston Villa 
 Bournemouth are causing problems for Villa with crosses from the flanks and one from the right goes through to Amine Adli, but he can't keep his first-time strike down.
